core.title: Iron Art Round Cabinet Knob, Acorn IKGBP

text.description_html:
Acorn IKGJP, Round Iron Art Cabinet Knob

If you ever wonder what the perfect accent for your traditional home is the, Iron Art Round Cabinet Knob is the answer. Handmade using the traditional forge, each piece is shaped using an anvil and hammer, giving it a charming rustic look. Just so, each piece is a little different, a little work of art. The black iron finish mimics the look of naturally weathered metal that is backed by a lifetime warranty. Because of its beautiful styling, this cabinet knob has an earthy feel that is both elegant and humble.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Round Iron Art Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
